title: an unobserved spawned failure at shutdown
purpose: Record how an unobserved task failure affects completion.

failure.justification: D-034 (owner decision): the unobserved failure is reported and the run fails; whether the runtime reports it as the task's uncaught error or a runtime failure is not fixed.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: async guide 6.4 and language owner decision 19.10.2026 (D-034): an unobserved error is reported and the run fails with a nonzero status.

notes: D-034: language owner decision 19.10.2026 — the run fails with a nonzero status.
